LESSON: PROJECT ACTIVITY (FURNITURE ITEM)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: WOODWORK
Strand: Wood Processes and Products
Topic 3.4: Project Activity (Furniture Item)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 24

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Project Activity (Furniture Item), part of Wood Processes and Products in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 WOODWORK.

Key inquiry question: How do you carry out a woodwork project?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
